assumptions.statement: The Overall Design Area and all three key-area polygons are provisional rough geometries used only for concept location, visualization, and temporary recomputation. Community cross-check Issue #846 reports 0% intersection coverage and a 412.5 m separation between PROV-SITE-001 and the OSM-mapped built heritage park; this submission has not independently reproduced the measurement, and neither source is official.
assumptions.statement_zh: 总体设计范围及三处重点区的 polygon 均为临时粗略几何，只用于概念定位、展示和临时复算。社区复核 Issue #846 报告 PROV-SITE-001 与 OSM 已测绘的遗址公园相交覆盖率为 0%、最近相距 412.5 m；本投稿未独立复现该测量，且两者都不是官方边界。
assumptions.impact: No polygon edge, area calculation, adjacency, park relationship, station relationship, parcel relationship, or project position is an official redline or precise planning conclusion; the concept does not prove that SITE-001 contains the real heritage park.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Replace with rights-cleared official GIS/CAD polygons and a verified base map, then regenerate every geometry, metric, drawing, and HTML view. If the park and Overall Design Area do not intersect, relocate the corridor to a verified public walking network and keep the park as an external connection.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 取得已清权且坐标参考系经核验的官方 GIS/CAD polygon 与底图后，替换全部临时几何并重新生成图层、指标、图件和 HTML；若遗址公园与总体设计范围不相交，则把廊道迁入经核验的公共慢行网络，并把公园保留为外部联系。

assumptions.statement: The fixed 2026-08-14 Overpass response is a dated, mutable OSM street-centreline cross-check for four roads named in the announcement. It is not a basemap for design, an official boundary, a road redline, a parcel edge, a formal scoring source, or evidence that any provisional geometry is correct or incorrect.
assumptions.statement_zh: 2026-08-14 固定的 Overpass 响应只是对公告命名四条道路所作的、带时点且会随 OSM 更新的街道中线背景核对；它不是设计底图、官方边界、道路红线、宗地边、正式评分资料，也不能证明任何 provisional 几何正确或错误。
assumptions.impact: The derived 533–898 m eastward offsets and 667 m mean remain contextual warning signals only. They do not move SITE-001 or a key area, create an area or adjacency claim, alter a metric, or decide the Issue #846 heritage-park relationship. The raw OSM response is not redistributed in this submission.
assumptions.impact_zh: 533–898 m 的东偏读数与 667 m 均值只保留为背景警示信号；它们不移动 SITE-001 或重点区，不产生面积/邻接结论，不修改指标，也不裁决 Issue #846 所述遗址公园关系。本投稿不再分发 OSM 原始响应。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: When rights-cleared official polygons, road definitions, and a verified planning basemap arrive, professional teams must compare those authoritative inputs directly and regenerate the proposal. Any later OSM rerun must be a new dated observation with its own exact query, API/base timestamps, response hash, ODbL attribution, coverage limits, and background-only label.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 取得已清权的官方 polygon、道路口径和经核验规划底图后，由专业团队直接比较权威资料并整体重算方案。若以后重跑 OSM，须作为新的带日期观测，重新记录固定查询、API/base 时间戳、响应哈希、ODbL 署名、覆盖限制与 background-only 标签。

assumptions.statement: The three key areas are differentiated by the official names, north-to-south order, approximate announced areas, and task descriptions, not by verified parcel-level locations.
assumptions.statement_zh: 三处重点区仅依据官方名称、南北顺序、公告约面积与任务描述区分，并非经宗地级核验的位置。
assumptions.impact: Zhongzhiyuan, Beijing AI Origin Community, and Dazhongsi program assignments are directional briefs; the current Dazhongsi polygon in particular does not prove exact relation to Dazhongsi Station or a four-quadrant intersection.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Obtain official key-area boundaries, station/interface drawings, and planning-base maps, then relocate the concept nodes through professional review.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 取得官方重点区边界、站点/接口图和规划底图后，经专业评审重新定位概念节点。

assumptions.statement: Regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, heritage-control lines, municipal utilities, fire access, underground conditions, and engineering constraints are not available in the public package.
assumptions.statement_zh: 公开资料未提供法定控制、道路红线、权属、文保控制线、市政管线、消防通道、地下条件和工程约束。
assumptions.impact: FAR, height, density, setbacks, demolition, road capacity, parking supply, utility capacity, and construction feasibility remain unknown; all physical moves are conceptual recommendations.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Qualified planning, architecture, transport, municipal, fire, heritage, and ownership teams review the official attachments and surveys.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 由具备资格的规划、建筑、交通、市政、消防、文保和权属团队审查官方附件与实测资料。

assumptions.statement: Submitted building polygons represent program envelopes and project anchors, not surveyed existing buildings or approved new construction.
assumptions.statement_zh: 提交的建筑 polygon 只是功能包络与项目锚点，不代表实测现状建筑或已批准新建工程。
assumptions.impact: The retain-renovate-demolish strategy is a decision protocol only; no specific building is designated for demolition and no floor area is claimed.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete building survey, structural and heritage assessment, ownership review, operating-needs study, and statutory approval.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 完成建筑普查、结构与文保评估、权属核验、运营需求研究和法定审批后再深化。

assumptions.statement: Road and connector geometries express desired walking, cycling, service, and station-access relationships rather than road or rail engineering alignments.
assumptions.statement_zh: 道路与连接线几何表达步行、骑行、后勤和站点接驳关系，不代表道路或轨道工程线位。
assumptions.impact: No claim is made about track position, station entrance, intersection engineering, traffic capacity, bridge/tunnel feasibility, or accessibility compliance.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Validate against official transport base maps, observed desire lines, accessibility audit, traffic counts, and safety assessment.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 结合官方交通底图、现场出行轨迹、无障碍审计、交通计数和安全评估重新核验。

assumptions.statement: Power, cooling, communications, water, drainage, waste, emergency-power, and network-isolation proposals are service principles, not capacity calculations.
assumptions.statement_zh: 电力、冷却、通信、给排水、废弃物、应急电源和网络隔离均为服务原则，不是容量计算。
assumptions.impact: No data-center scale, energy load, carbon benefit, drainage performance, or municipal sufficiency is asserted.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Obtain utility inventories and demand profiles, then conduct qualified capacity, safety, lifecycle-carbon, and climate-resilience studies.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 取得管线清单和需求曲线后，由专业团队开展容量、安全、全生命周期碳和气候韧性研究。

assumptions.statement: Every vulnerability, dependency, release, permission, recall, service interruption, and recovery event in the submission is fictional and non-exploitable.
assumptions.statement_zh: 本投稿中的漏洞、依赖、发布、权限、召回、服务中断与恢复事件全部为虚构且不可利用。
assumptions.impact: Simulation outputs demonstrate only the internal evidence contract; they are not evidence of a real incident, real affected organization, production readiness, legal compliance, or security certification.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Any future live exercise requires written scope, safe-test authorization, isolated systems, qualified coordination, legal review, data minimization, stop conditions, and post-exercise deletion rules.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 未来开展真实演练前，必须具备书面范围、安全测试授权、隔离系统、专业协调、法律审查、数据最小化、停止条件和演练后删除规则。

assumptions.statement: The public learning layer contains only sanitized lessons, mitigation status, service impacts, and human alternatives; exploit details, secrets, personal data, and unpatched-system locations are excluded.
assumptions.statement_zh: 公共学习层只呈现脱敏经验、缓解状态、服务影响与人工替代，不公开利用细节、秘密、个人数据和未修复系统位置。
assumptions.impact: A future disclosure desk cannot publish or route a real report until a lawful, role-based coordinated-disclosure process and secure intake channel exist.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Qualified product-security, legal, public-communications, and affected-operator teams approve the intake, embargo, notification, publication, and retention rules.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 由产品安全、法律、公共沟通和受影响运营方审核接收、保密期、通知、发布与留存规则。

assumptions.statement: External vulnerability, supply-chain, AI-risk, and authorization materials are mechanism references; they do not determine Chinese legal duties for any future operator or artifact.
assumptions.statement_zh: 外部漏洞、供应链、AI 风险与授权资料只作为机制参考，不决定未来运营者或制品在中国适用的法律义务。
assumptions.impact: No universal reporting deadline, safe-harbor promise, cross-border sharing permission, compliance determination, or authorization to test third-party systems is created by this proposal.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Before operation, counsel and competent authorities determine applicable law, reporting routes, data localization, cross-border restrictions, contracts, and sector rules.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 投入运营前，由法律顾问和主管机构确认适用法律、报告路径、数据本地化、跨境限制、合同和行业规则。

assumptions.statement: On 2026-08-10, LiuLin1220 explicitly selected CC-BY-4.0 for original submission materials to the extent the contributor can grant those rights; third-party sources, standards, trademarks, fonts, repository code, and other rights outside the contributor's control remain under their own terms.
assumptions.statement_zh: 2026-08-10，LiuLin1220 明确选择在投稿者有权授权的范围内，以 CC-BY-4.0 提供本投稿的原创材料；第三方来源、标准、商标、字体、仓库代码及投稿者控制范围外的其他权利继续适用各自条款。
assumptions.impact: Reuse requires appropriate attribution, a license link, and an indication of changes without implying endorsement; the license does not expand rights in excluded third-party material.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Recheck the rights inventory and attribution notice whenever assets or sources change, and stop publication if an unlicensed third-party element is introduced.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 资产或来源变化时重新核对权利清单与署名说明；若引入未经许可的第三方内容，则停止发布。

assumptions.statement: The concept uses public, aggregate, synthetic, or explicitly authorized operational data and rejects facial recognition, persistent person tracking, individualized commercial profiling, and automated final decisions about people.
assumptions.statement_zh: 本概念只使用公开、聚合、合成或明确授权的运营数据，拒绝人脸识别、持续人员追踪、个体商业画像和对人的自动最终决策。
assumptions.impact: Scenario operation requires purpose limitation, minimal retention, accessible notice, opt-out where applicable, human review, contestability, and a non-digital service path.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Complete privacy, accessibility, discrimination, labor, and community-impact assessments for each selected live scenario.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 对每个拟上线场景完成隐私、无障碍、歧视、劳动和社区影响评估。

assumptions.statement: SLSA, Sigstore, CycloneDX, SPDX, NIST, MCP, CERT/CC, FIRST, and CISA sources are used as reference mechanisms and design precedents.
assumptions.statement_zh: SLSA、Sigstore、CycloneDX、SPDX、NIST、MCP、CERT/CC、FIRST 和 CISA 资料只作为机制参考与设计先例。
assumptions.impact: The package claims no conformance, assurance level, certification, verified signature, production SBOM/VEX, or deployed authorization implementation.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: A future operator must select applicable versions, define a conformity target, implement controls, preserve evidence, and obtain independent assessment where a claim is desired.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 未来运营者须选择适用版本、定义符合性目标、实施控制、保存证据，并在需要作出声明时取得独立评估。

assumptions.statement: Project owners, budgets, procurement routes, land availability, partnerships, annual events, and operating bodies are proposed roles rather than confirmed commitments.
assumptions.statement_zh: 项目责任人、预算、采购路径、土地可用性、合作关系、年度活动与运营主体均为建议角色，不是已确认承诺。
assumptions.impact: The three phases express dependency order and reversible pilots, not an approved schedule or investment plan.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Confirm governance mandate, site access, responsible operator, funding, procurement, maintenance capacity, public participation, and exit obligations.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 确认治理授权、场地准入、责任运营者、资金、采购、维护能力、公众参与和退出义务。

assumptions.statement: Spatial metrics derive from provisional design geometry, while integrity, scenario, and recall metrics derive from declared synthetic evidence.
assumptions.statement_zh: 空间指标来自临时设计几何，验真、场景与召回指标来自已声明的合成证据。
assumptions.impact: Values can support package consistency checks but cannot be used for statutory area scoring, real-world performance claims, procurement, or public-service assurance.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Recompute spatial metrics after official data replacement and operational metrics after an authorized, observed pilot with a published measurement protocol.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 官方数据替换后重算空间指标；在有授权、可观测且公布测量协议的试点后再计算运营指标。

assumptions.statement: As of 2026-08-21, this v0.5 package contains zero verified P04 field-observation records, zero confirmed responsible-entity records, zero written venue-authorization records, and zero comparable independent quote records. These are counts of qualifying evidence in the submitted package, not claims that nothing exists outside it.
assumptions.statement_zh: 截至 2026-08-21，本 v0.5 投稿包内可核验的 P04 现场观察记录、已确认责任主体记录、书面场地授权记录和可比独立报价记录均为 0。这只是对投稿包内合格证据的计数，不声称包外不存在相关资料。
assumptions.impact: The five service zones, eight role slots, four decision gates, and six negative cases are a conceptual audit contract only. Every role holder is UNASSIGNED, so no live intake, public service, procurement, installation, site access, or organizational commitment is authorized.
assumptions.impact_zh: 五个服务区、八个角色槽位、四道决策门和六个负例只是概念审计合同。全部角色持有人均为“未指派”，因此不授权真实接入、公共服务、采购、安装、场地进入或组织承诺。
assumptions.recalculation_trigger: Add only dated and attributable records with lawful scope, responsible-entity acceptance, venue-owner authorization, and rights-cleared evidence. Before procurement, obtain two independent written quotes on the same frozen quantities, service period, tax, installation, maintenance, removal, and handover scope; then regenerate metrics, figures, HTML, PDFs, manifest hashes, and self-check.
assumptions.recalculation_trigger_zh: 仅在资料具备日期、可归责主体、合法范围、责任主体书面接受、场地方书面授权和清权证据时增加记录。采购前须取得两份独立书面报价，并使用同一冻结数量、服务周期、税费、安装、维护、撤场和移交口径；随后重新生成指标、图件、HTML、PDF、manifest 哈希和自检。

service_zones.resources_zh: 双语状态牌、纸面分诊单、无障碍等候位和可核查回执
service_zones.resources_en: bilingual status board, paper triage form, accessible waiting position, and verifiable receipt
service_zones.acceptance_zh: 公众能读取版本、影响、行动、人工替代和责任槽位，并取得时间戳回执
service_zones.acceptance_en: a visitor can read version, impact, action, staffed alternative, and responsible slot and receive a timestamped receipt
service_zones.exit_zh: 未经批准的公告、无障碍路径不可达或回执不可核查时关闭分诊并转人工安全渠道
service_zones.exit_en: close triage and route to a safe staffed channel when notice is uncleared, the accessible route fails, or the receipt is unverifiable

service_zones.name_zh: 人工连续服务与回执区
service_zones.resources_zh: 纸面业务流程、离线名册、回拨队列和同层无障碍柜台
service_zones.resources_en: paper service procedure, offline roster, callback queue, and same-level accessible counter
service_zones.acceptance_zh: 数字路径暂停后仍能完成冻结任务并留下人工接管、处理和下次复核回执
service_zones.acceptance_en: the frozen task remains completable after digital suspension with a receipt for human takeover, disposition, and next review
service_zones.exit_zh: 值守缺席、纸面流程失效或同层替代不可达时停止面向公众的试点
service_zones.exit_en: stop the public-facing pilot when staffing is absent, the paper process fails, or the same-level alternative is unreachable

service_zones.resources_zh: 版本化合成依赖图、受影响/未知/不受影响及理由卡、通知与回执台账
service_zones.resources_en: versioned synthetic dependency graph, affected/unknown/not-affected-with-reason cards, and notice/acknowledgement ledger
service_zones.acceptance_zh: 每个合成下游项均保留责任槽位、状态理由、通知路径和未关闭未知项
service_zones.acceptance_en: every synthetic downstream item retains a responsible slot, state reason, notice route, and visible unresolved unknowns
service_zones.exit_zh: 真实主体或生产数据误入、影响范围无责任槽位或未知项被自动改写为安全时封存并停止
service_zones.exit_en: seal the record and stop if a real entity or production datum enters, affected scope lacks a responsible slot, or automation rewrites unknown as safe

service_zones.resources_zh: 隔离工作位、冻结测试套件、补丁摘要、回滚包和复测日志
service_zones.resources_en: isolated workstation, frozen test suite, patch summary, rollback bundle, and retest log
service_zones.acceptance_zh: 合成修复可在隔离环境复现，回滚可执行，复测结果和失败均被保留
service_zones.acceptance_en: the synthetic repair is reproducible in isolation, rollback executes, and both retest results and failures are retained
service_zones.exit_zh: 出现真实漏洞细节、生产凭据、越权、回滚失败或删除不可验证时立即隔离并结束演练
service_zones.exit_en: isolate and end the exercise upon real exploit detail, production credentials, excessive privilege, rollback failure, or unverifiable deletion

service_zones.resources_zh: 撤场清单、数据删除证明、资产移交单、空间复原记录和脱敏归档索引
service_zones.resources_en: de-installation checklist, deletion evidence, asset-handover form, space-restoration record, and sanitized archive index
service_zones.acceptance_zh: 接收人、资产、数据、空间、未决事项和下次复核均有签收记录
service_zones.acceptance_en: recipient, assets, data, space, open issues, and next review all have signed records
service_zones.exit_zh: D90 为停止/修改或责任、资金、授权、接收人任一缺失时撤场、删除、复原且不续期
service_zones.exit_en: de-install, delete, restore, and do not renew when D90 decides stop/revise or responsibility, funding, authorization, or recipient is missing

role_slots.title_zh: 授权、采购与法务复核席
下游服务责任人与采购知会席

decision_gates.meaning_zh: 核验主体、场地、数据和安全授权，指派并书面接受角色，冻结合成范围、基线和停止门；缺一项即不启动
decision_gates.meaning_en: verify entity, venue, data, and safety authorization; assign and accept roles in writing; freeze synthetic scope, baseline, and stop gates; otherwise do not start

decision_gates.meaning_zh: 在获授权既有空间完成五区可逆样机和桌面演练；未获场地授权时只能离场模拟
decision_gates.meaning_en: complete a reversible five-zone mock-up and tabletop in an authorized existing room; without venue authorization remain off-site and synthetic

decision_gates.meaning_zh: 通过断网、无障碍、人工替代、回滚、删除与六个负例测试后才可讨论受控公开演练
decision_gates.meaning_en: only discuss a controlled public exercise after offline, accessibility, staffed fallback, rollback, deletion, and six negative-case tests pass

decision_gates.meaning_zh: 由独立观察形成继续、修改或停止；继续只授权下一轮有界试验，不自动触发采购、招商或永久建设
decision_gates.meaning_en: independent observation decides go, revise, or stop; go authorizes only another bounded trial, never automatic procurement, attraction, or permanent construction

negative_cases.case_zh: 无书面场地授权仍拟进入、拍摄、安装或服务
negative_cases.case_en: entry, recording, installation, or service is proposed without written venue authorization

negative_cases.case_zh: 无已确认责任主体或 A01/R 席位未指派仍拟真实接入
negative_cases.case_en: live intake is proposed without a confirmed responsible entity or assigned A01/R slots

negative_cases.case_zh: 真实漏洞、个人数据、生产凭据或未经批准的主体名称进入演练/公开层
negative_cases.case_en: real exploit detail, personal data, production credentials, or an uncleared entity name enters the exercise or public layer

negative_cases.case_zh: 人工替代、无障碍路径或纸面流程不可达
negative_cases.case_en: staffed fallback, accessible route, or paper procedure is unavailable

negative_cases.case_zh: 回滚、删除、回执或空间复原证据不可验证
negative_cases.case_en: rollback, deletion, receipt, or space-restoration evidence is unverifiable

negative_cases.case_zh: 少于两份独立书面报价，或报价未采用同一冻结范围与全生命周期口径
negative_cases.case_en: fewer than two independent written quotes exist, or the quotes do not share one frozen scope and lifecycle basis
